summary: The ordinary /api/teaching/course-cover POST route now rejects signed teacher cookies whose actorId or sessionId is not a safe server identity before ownership checks, Qwen generation, cover asset persistence, or existing-course binding writes can run.

redGreenEvidence.observed: Both unsafe signed teacher identity regressions failed with HTTP 502 instead of the expected HTTP 401, proving the route accepted validly signed unsafe identity fields into downstream course-cover handling instead of failing closed at the auth boundary.

behaviorHardened: Signed course-cover cookies whose actorId fails the safe-id boundary now resolve as unauthenticated and return HTTP 401 with authenticated-session-required.
Signed course-cover cookies whose sessionId fails the safe-id boundary now resolve as unauthenticated and return HTTP 401 with authenticated-session-required.
Unsafe signed actor ids are rejected before external teacher ownership requests, Qwen client creation/generation, cover asset writes, or audit writes.
Unsafe signed session ids are rejected before provisional-course Qwen generation, cover asset writes, course-cover audit events, or existing-course binding writes.
The denial responses preserve trace id and redaction without echoing unsafe local-path or secret-like identity values.

verification.observed: 66 files passed, 1307 tests passed. Existing jsdom navigation warnings remained non-fatal.

boundary: This is local backend/API auth-boundary hardening for the main teaching course-cover generation route. It does not replace fresh same-run live production ordinary teaching route/browser smoke artifacts, does not prove live DashScope generation, and does not clear the aggregate enterprise gate.
